title: VS-107 — Complete Kairo V2 Product Flow

notes: Reframes Home around one next creation action.
Connects the isolated v2 Home to existing Brand-scoped recommendations, simple creation and continuation contracts.
Reuses the approved provider-neutral OIDC flow on the v2 hostname without changing identity-provider policy.
Adds the approved v2 Discover collection and Discover Preview using existing Brand-scoped Opportunity contracts.
Adds the approved v2 Content List and Content Preview using existing Brand-scoped Campaign, Content Asset, review and calendar contracts.
Adds the approved v2 Campaign List and Campaign Preview using the same Brand-scoped Campaign, Content Asset, review and calendar contracts.
Adds the approved v2 Calendar with Month, Week and List views plus contextual scheduling interactions.
Adds the approved v2 Insights overview with evidence-aware performance summaries and Content Preview routing.
Adds the approved v2 Brand Brain experience with Overview, Brand DNA, Discovery Intelligence, Sources and Learning tabs.
Uses Discovery Intelligence in creator-facing language while keeping Hunter as the internal background engine.
Keeps Brand DNA review local through inline Edit, Save and Cancel interactions with visible evidence and confirmation state.
Does not change Hunter algorithms, API contracts, providers, publishing authority or autonomous scheduling.

approvals.rationale: Product Owner approved the combined Brand Brain v2 direction: readiness-first Overview, inline-editable Brand DNA and a transparent Discovery Intelligence search plan, with Sources and Learning in the same design system.

The existing Brand Brain, Source, Learning and Discovery contracts remain authoritative; the change is frontend-only and introduces no new provider, data authority, credential, scheduling or publishing policy.
Product Owner explicitly instructed the approved Brand Brain mockup to proceed and approved the combined implementation direction with local inline editing.
Product Owner approved certification of the exact VS-107@1.7 Brand Brain candidate after CI, Security, Product Intake, runtime verification, UI tests and deployed preview browser QA passed.
Product Owner explicitly instructed merging PR #261 after exact-SHA certification; production deployment remains manual.
Awaiting certified release approval and a separate production-enable decision.
